accept_criteria: Palettes align with themes from content_brief and analysis_state
Sonic identity and palette entries are internally consistent
No palette references themes absent from upstream brief
Coherence fields present for downstream sound_design_plan stages
Palette tags and segment mappings can be traced to sonic_context tag_registry provenance and scenario posture
reject_patterns: Empty palettes when themes exist upstream
Palette theme ids that do not match brief topic or theme ids
Schema errors on required palette or coherence fields
Palette keywords or segment_ids are not traceable to sonic_context tag_registry provenance
